findings.reproduction: Scroll the long docs sidebar to its bottom at1280x720.
findings.symptom: Thumb is clipped below its rail and visible hit geometry disagrees with scroll travel.
findings.expected: The full thumb stays within the rail and uses the same dimensions as drag/position calculation.
findings.rootCause: Radix computes an18px minimum thumb; CSS forced36px minimum height/width. On a249px rail the library's223px travel exceeded the available space for36px paint.
findings.fix: Aligned vertical/horizontal CSS minimum to Radix18px floor, preserving custom contour and grip.
verification: Before: rail bottom465px; thumb bottom478.94px, height36px.
After: bottom thumb height18px and bottom460.89px inside rail464.97px.
Drag filtered164.4px thumb from bottom to top reached native scrollTop0.
Resize1440x980->1280x720 recalculated36.49px->18px thumb with matching native position.
limits: No horizontal live fixture exercised yet.

findings.reproduction: Scroll sidebar to bottom, then type button in Find a component.
findings.symptom: Only4 matching links remain but sidebar is blank, with stale scroll range/thumb.
findings.expected: Filtered results determine actual scroll range; removed highlights cannot retain old overflow.
findings.rootCause: Flow painter hide only set opacity0 and retained positioned layer geometry. Hover/selection layers at removed rows retained thousands of pixels of native overflow. Delayed cleanup also let Radix cache obsolete content height.
findings.fix: Clear hidden painter geometry after fade; cancel stale completion on renewed paint; clear hovered geometry when content changes and immediately hide removed selected targets.
verification: Before: filtered nav height365px, viewport scrollHeight6286px and scrollTop6037.5px; screenshot visibly blank.
After: scrollHeight365px, scrollTop116px, thumb164.4px aligned to rail bottom.
No-results: scrollHeight=clientHeight249px, scrollTop0, thumb absent. Clear-search restored6987px list.
New regression tests showed2 failures before implementation. After fix14 focused tests pass for painter hide/retarget, choreography and scroll shape.
Alternative live FlowGroup consumers: combobox filter+selection and ButtonGroup selection retained visible outcomes. Reduced-motion sidebar filter also passed.
limits: All live flow character variants and every group consumer are not exhaustively browser-covered; alternate combobox and ButtonGroup verified.
Full component browser/responsive/variant audit remains ongoing.
